title: A Strong Candidate Gene for Nonsyndromic Intellectual Disability Phenotype: SGSM3.

reviewer.method: Read all164 structured main-text lines including17references and endmatter; reread lines48–92 to repair a truncated tool result. Inspected Figures1–2 and graphical abstract. Opened all5 public peer-review items in Chrome; read both decision letters, both standalone reviews and downloaded the author response. Read every response paragraph and both rendered DOCX pages. Compared both sibling packets and all16 phenotype assertions.

audit.exposure_note: Prior compact-cohort aggregate results seen; no SGSM3 per-case rank consulted. Post-inference audit, not blinded.

Full source/linked-review reading is not experimental replication, clinical truth or demonstrated drug efficacy.
Other filtered candidates (XPNPEP3,TTLL1,RTL9) are named but exact variants and complete rejection data are not supplied; no independent differential diagnosis is claimed.
The published author-response rationale does not replace a formal independent gene-disease validity or ACMG evidence audit.
The paper’s 15cases/9families includes13previous cases; it is not15new independent observations.
No SGSM3 functional experiment, N1002K/BubR1 measurement or drug-rescue experiment was performed in this source.
